discription: A warm pad sound using a pulse oscillator with slight pulse width modulation and a resonant low-pass filter.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pan=0, attack=0.01, decay=0.8, sustain=0.5, release=1.0, rq=0.5, cutoff=2000;var sig, env, lfo;env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);lfo = LFTri.kr(0.5).range(0.1, 0.9);sig = Pulse.ar(freq, lfo);sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq);sig = sig * amp * env;Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan));}
